name: Md Jahidul Islam
title: Yangbin Wang Rising Star Endowed Assistant Professor
fitReason: Strong CS-method overlap through learned semantic perception deployed on marine robots, plus geometric scene reconstruction for human teleoperation. A bounded project could study robust perception or operator interfaces rather than require designing new underwater hardware.

physicalEvidence.summary: CavePI (RSS 2025) runs MobileNetV3/DeepLabV3 segmentation on a Jetson Nano, feeding visual waypoints to a physical AUV controller in tank, spring and cave trials. Its dark-cave tests needed diver repositioning after perception failures; the navigation was not uniformly autonomous. EgoExo++ (IJRR 2026) adds geometry-based exocentric views using actual BlueROV2 cave imagery. Its 15-person real-data study is playback, while the second active-teleoperation study and performance gains are Gazebo simulation.
